title: Workflow close transition + zombie-proof picker (D1+D2)
action: REPRO CONTEXT (recorded, 3 incidents 2026-07-28): bee-state-sync on SubagentStop rebuilds the projection; with current.feature momentarily falsy, pickNewestActiveWorkflow resurrects a prior feature because nothing ever closes workflows. FIX per CONTEXT D1/D2: (1) in packages/bee/lib/state.mjs startFeature (~:2827-3011), inside the same guarded mutation that creates the new workflow (~:3001-3008), set the OUTGOING feature's live workflow record(s) to status 'closed' (workflow-store update path; only records whose feature differs from the new feature and status 'active'). (2) in packages/bee/lib/state-projection.mjs pickNewestActiveWorkflow (~:149-159), exclude records with phase 'compounding-complete' in addition to the existing status filtering. Keep both changes surgical; no other lifecycle semantics change. Run targeted existing suites green: the suites covering workflow-store and state-projection (locate via rg) plus packages/bee/tests/test_state.mjs. Red-first evidence: BEFORE the fix, write a throwaway probe in .bee/spikes/foundation-fixes/ seeding two workflows (one active+compounding-complete zombie, one live) with feature unset, showing the picker selects the zombie; quote it in your report, then show the same probe green after. Vendored .bee/bin regen DEFERRED (wave-barrier ack).

truths: After startFeature for a new feature, every prior feature's workflow record has status 'closed' (probe evidence quoted).
pickNewestActiveWorkflow never returns a compounding-complete record (probe before/after quoted).
Targeted existing suites green (list them + results in report).
prohibitions: Do NOT touch bee-state-sync.mjs or hooks.
Do NOT change any other startFeature semantics (gate resets, lane handling).

regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier: regen deferred to orchestrator at wave close (parallel-default D2)

trace.outcome: startFeature now closes the outgoing feature's live workflow record(s) on the next start (D1); pickNewestActiveWorkflow additionally excludes compounding-complete records (D2), defense in depth. Red-first probe (deleted, throwaway) reproduced both zombie shapes before the fix and confirmed green after; existing test_state.mjs (43) + test_workflow_store.mjs (15) stay green, 0 failed.
